faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Srinagar District Court Class IV Posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the offline application form is 22 September 2026. Candidates are advised to send their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the Class IV posts?
faq.answer: For Process Server posts, candidates must have passed 10+2 from a recognised Board. For Orderly and Chowkidar posts, a 10th pass certificate from a recognised Board is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 43 years as of 01 January 2026. Age relaxation is provided for different categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Class IV posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 17 vacancies for Class IV posts, including 2 for Process Server and 15 for Orderly, Chowkidar.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Srinagar District Court Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 300 for all categories, including General, OBC, SC, and ST.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Viva Voce.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Class IV posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 14800 to Rs. 63100 per month, depending on the specific post.

faq.question: Q8. Is the application process online or offline?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Srinagar District Court: https://srinagar.dcourts.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and educational certificates.
